text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday to you. If you'll indulge 
me, I have prepared a small gift for you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Thank you very much. To go out of 
your way just for me... I am deeply 
honored.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that cycling is your hobby, I 
deemed it best to select something that 
would be of practical use to you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I heard you've been cycling on mountain 
trails lately. As such, I took the liberty 
of choosing all-terrain tires for you."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You even knew that we went to the mountain 
trail?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You certainly are well-informed. I thought 
I had only told McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since it is a gift, I thoroughly 
investigated your hobbies and daily 
habits, Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Or perhaps you would be interested in 
cycling equipment instead? In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You've been troubled by blurry selfies 
lately, haven't you? I can prepare a 
selfie stick with image stabilization for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that's not it at all...! If 
anything, it's quite the opposite."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was just deeply moved that you would go 
so far for me. Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Once again, Ruby-san... I would be 
delighted to accept your gift.
